import pandas as pd

# List of source CSV file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_32/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_32/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_32/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_32/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_32/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_32/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_32/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_32/training_7.csv"
]

# Target schema columns and types:
# 'created': string
# 'screenname': string
# 'followers': integer
# 'favourites': integer
# 'text': string (bytes represented as string in CSV)

# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are exactly as expected
    # Convert 'created' to string (remove timezone if any)
    # The source 'created' columns have timezone info in some files (e.g. Source0)
    # Target examples show no timezone, so strip timezone info if present
    df['created'] = df['created'].astype(str).str.replace(r'\+00:00$', '', regex=True)
    # Convert followers and favourites to integer (some might be float if any missing)
    df['followers'] = pd.to_numeric(df['followers'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df['favourites'] = pd.to_numeric(df['favourites'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    # screenname as string
    df['screenname'] = df['screenname'].astype(str)
    # text as string (bytes represented as string in CSV, keep as is)
    df['text'] = df['text'].astype(str)
    # Append cleaned df
    dfs.append(df)

# UNION operation: concatenate all dataframes vertically
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Reorder columns to match target schema explicitly (should already match)
target_df = target_df[['created', 'screenname', 'followers', 'favourites', 'text']]

# Write the result to the target CSV file path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_32/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
